name: Hallow's End: a Water Bucket thrown on a Goldshire training fire counts for Fire Brigade Practice
contract: 'Fire Brigade Practice' 11360 from Costumed Orphan Matron 24519 sends the player north of Goldshire, where Headless Horseman - Fire (DND) 23537 training fires burn during Hallow's End (event 12); its objective is five 23537 credits. Water Bucket 32971 casts Throw Bucket 42340, a missile to the chosen ground point that triggers Bucket Lands 42339 on units within 3 yd of it; a burning training fire hit by it is splashed by Water Splash 42348 and gives the thrower one credit (#9052). The Headless Horseman Flame Bunny 23686 fires of the Shade of the Horseman around the inn belong to 'Stop the Fires!' and give no practice credit. Client visuals are untested.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the event spawns live
The training fires north of Goldshire are spawned
11360 is in the log with no fire put out
Walk north to the practice area
SETUP: a Water Bucket from the barrel
Throw the bucket onto training fire 240016
The splashed training fire gives one credit
